Title: Deflect to Self, still valid?? WTF? LSJ?

Messages.Author: jeff...@pacbell.net
Messages.Body:
This situation comes up all the time, but I don't think this ruling is
common knowledge.

Deflection - Reaction (do) (1)
* Cannot be used to direct a bleed to a Methuselah who
would be an invalid target for a bleed (after Minor
Boon, e.g.) [RTR 950622]
* Can be used to redirect the bleed to yourself, thereby
granting you another opportunity to block. :B02:
[RTR 970630]

Is the second Deflection ruling still accurate?

This post indicates that is not the case any more:
http://tinyurl.com/m477e

I also noticed that the [RTR 970630] ruling is absent from this
location:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=rulings

Deflection
dom: Only usable when you are being bled. Tap this reacting vampire.
Choose another Methuselah other than the controller of the acting
minion. The acting minion is bleeding that Methuselah.
DOM: As above, but do not tap this vampire.
(from Monger)

That "choose another" text seems to require that the new chosen Meth
must be different from yourself.

Please clarify. I don't want to find out that I've played this card
wrong for the past several years. :)

Jeff

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Greg wrote:

> jeff...@pacbell.net wrote:
> > Is the second Deflection ruling still accurate?

Correct. You cannot use Deflection to choose yourself as the target of
the bleed.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
